subject: trs
title: TRS.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-35, first of two on book p179, on the page where Braxton argues that 'to view the vibrational and actual realness of western culture is to view non-white people as only supporting players — whose contributions, no matter how vast, do not really figure in the defining and controlling scheme that determines how events are to be culturally perceived.' TRS (transition) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what transition produces when crossed with composite continuance under the conditions of western cultural curation Braxton has just described. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and S-SH (source shift) feed the upper section. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and PRO-CONT (progressional continuance) are right-side outputs. RE-ST (restructuralism) is a central convergence. INFO-DE (information degrees), (P)DOC (the point of activation of documentation), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) form the lower constituting layer. Structural argument: transition crossed with composite continuance produces restructuralism as the central convergence, with the (p) prefix on documentation marking it as the *activation point* of documentation rather than its sustained state — meaning Braxton's diagrammatic claim is that real restructuralism requires documentation to be activated, not merely present.
